name: Bizotic Commercial Limited
summary: Bizotic Commercial Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing, styling, and commercialization of ready-to-wear apparel and textile goods. The company's diverse collection of menswear includes formal, casual, festive, athletic, comfort, ethnic, and winter clothing lines. Additionally, they provide outsourced fabric processing services. The firm was established on December 29, 2016, and its main office is located in Ahmedabad, India.
